description: This file defines a helper class for managing an SQLite database of notes in an Android application. It includes schema definitions, creation and upgrade logic, and extends the SQLiteOpenHelper class.

classes.name: NoteDbHelper
classes.description: A SQLiteOpenHelper subclass for creating, managing, and upgrading the notes database.

methods.name: NoteDbHelper
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the database helper with the context.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Creates the notes database by executing the SQL create table statement.

methods.name: onUpgrade
methods.description: Handles database upgrades by dropping the existing table and recreating it.
